summary: An employer offers a transfer or another role and wants an answer by the end of the day.
realLife: Layoff-meeting stories include an employer giving the worker until the end of the day to decide on another role, which workers read as pressure that ignores their circumstances.
sources: Welcome to the Jungle, frustrating phrases from layoff meetings: https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/articles/frustrating-phrases-from-layoff-meetings
inGame: the job-ended event and a later job record could carry the transfer; needs: transfer offers and deadlines

turns.summary: The worker asks for more time and the manager grants it.
turns.writesBack: a kept favor; trust with the manager

turns.summary: The worker accepts at once to end the meeting.
turns.writesBack: a later regret in the journal

turns.summary: The manager says the line is firm and the offer lapses.
turns.writesBack: the job is lost; a grudge
